candidates.title: Malformed action syntax no-op
candidates.trigger: Agent output does not parse as search[...] or click[...]
candidates.proposed_feedback_intent: Explain the accepted WebShop action grammar without naming any benchmark answer.

candidates.title: Action outside visible affordance set
candidates.trigger: click target not visible, click[search], empty search, or search submitted without a visible search bar
ambiguous_causes: agent clicked a label from an older page
agent confused search button with search action
agent searched from product page instead of using visible navigation
candidates.proposed_feedback_intent: Point back to the current/previous public available action set.

candidates.title: Compact page affordance cue
candidates.trigger: Current page is search, search results, item page, or item subpage
ambiguous_causes: long observations make page mode hard to identify
selected product options are spread across page text
navigation and purchase affordances are easy to miss
candidates.proposed_feedback_intent: Summarize page mode and visible affordances already present in observation/available_actions.

priors.non_leakage: safe if restricted to visible state
